exports.label: Coke and semi-coke (customs data)
exports.n: Customs data record 1.63 Mt of coke and semi-coke exported from Mozambique in 2024 (CEPII BACI, HS 2704), 4.7% of the world total. The EIA table of metallurgical coke production on the Metallurgical coal page gives Mozambique no coke production in 2025 (its series reads 0 in every year from 1980 to 2025; EIA International Energy Data). These tonnes may be another product declared under the coke code, coal for instance, which the EIA tables of the Metallurgical coal page show Mozambique exporting (6.5 Mt in 2025): a possible reading, not established here.

imports.label: Chromium ore
imports.n: Mozambique is not a producer or an exporter of this product in these tables, and the customs data record most of its imports as arriving overland: these tonnes may be cargo in transit to a port, and not the country's own use (a possible reading, not established here): the ore comes overland from South Africa, the first producer in the USGS table of this page; Mozambique has no line in that table; and its own exports of ore in the customs data are next to nothing
